operations.name: encode_buffer
operations.summary: Compresses a caller-provided plaintext buffer with the one-shot encoder. This is the main hot-path workload and exercises realistic match finding, histogram building, metablock construction, and bitstream emission.
operations.input_format: Raw uncompressed bytes to be brotli-compressed; seeds/perf inputs are structured, highly repetitive text-like data with repeated records and substrings.
operations.digest: Folds encoder success/failure, encoded size, encoder version, and a checksum over selected bytes of the produced compressed buffer.

operations.name: decode_buffer
operations.summary: Decompresses a complete brotli payload with the one-shot decoder. Valid seeds are generated by running the library's own encoder first so the decoder processes accepted end-to-end inputs.
operations.input_format: A valid complete brotli-compressed blob produced by this crate's encoder from deterministic structured source data.
operations.digest: Folds decode result/error, decoded size, decoder version, and a checksum over selected bytes of the decompressed output.

operations.name: stream_roundtrip
operations.summary: Runs streaming encode followed by streaming decode on the same payload, exercising stateful APIs, incremental I/O, take-output paths, and finished/has-more-output status checks.
operations.input_format: Raw uncompressed bytes; the runner first stream-compresses them into a brotli byte stream, then stream-decompresses that stream back to plaintext.
operations.digest: Folds encoder and decoder status codes, compressed and decompressed byte counts, finished/used flags, and checksums of both intermediate compressed bytes and final round-tripped plaintext.

operations.name: shared_dict_roundtrip
operations.summary: Builds and attaches a prepared/shared dictionary for both encoder and decoder, then performs a dictionary-assisted compress/decompress cycle. This covers dictionary-management APIs and dictionary-aware codec paths.
operations.input_format: Raw bytes whose prefix is a small deterministic dictionary blob followed by body content intentionally containing many dictionary-reusable phrases; the harness derives the dictionary from the input itself in a deterministic way.
operations.digest: Folds prepared-dictionary size, attach success/failure codes, stream encode/decode results, output sizes, and a checksum over the final decompressed bytes.

seed_strategy: For encode_buffer and stream_roundtrip, write two distinct plaintext inputs made from deterministic synthetic corpora: repeated log/JSON-like records, English words, path fragments, timestamps, and recurring templates, with one seed smaller and more repetitive and the other larger and more varied. For decode_buffer, first generate two distinct plaintext corpora as above, then call BrotliEncoderCompress to serialize them into valid brotli payloads and save those compressed bytes as the seeds. For shared_dict_roundtrip, write two distinct raw inputs whose first fixed-size region serves as the dictionary source and whose remainder reuses many phrases from that region; the runner deterministically splits input into dictionary/body. For perf data, emit large but not huge structured corpora (hundreds of KB to a few MB) using the same templates; for decode_buffer specifically, always generate the perf blob by compressing that large corpus with this crate's encoder so decode runs to completion on valid compressed input.
